items.claim: One-shot ready_at starts a single issued idle; repeated silence does not renew; a first frame at or after 60s still fails startup.
items.reason: worker-startup-vad-race-red.log is a real rustc test failure: Close(IdleNoProgress) vs Keep, 526 passed, 1 failed. A 160-sample frame at 40s is classified only after a 32ms window, and the issued idle minimum 5000ms covers that window. STARTUP_BUDGET_MS is 60000 and first_frame uses a strict less-than. The watchdog unit fixture's 30000 is an injected scale. Issued idle stays the signed 5-300s value. Silence after that one interval closes on idle and does not fall back to 60s.
items.condition: input_frame may call first_frame once when sample_count>0 and must not call progress for length or silence.

items.claim: Packets after begin_to_end are an expired generation. The whole-job close still needs one issued-idle grace on the single FirstTurn to Rtc switch.
items.reason: ordered_pcm on_tick fails Timeout when Receiving or Ended exceeds begin_to_end_timeout_ms (default 7000). That withdraws the earlier claim that packets still arriving at 8s are a legal upload. Terminal/no_task clears the Input hold. ready_at does not cover a handoff that itself lasted longer than idle. Default local receipt is ordered_end_seen_at plus 3000ms, and the signed idle minimum is 5000ms, so the default gate fits the one-shot grace. The output gate is a fixed 5s. No extra seconds are added.
items.minimal_change: At the one pending_phase_switch application that sets InputPhase::Rtc, arm rtc_grace_at or one Input activity whose budget is the signed idle_ms. Do not slide it on later packets, polls, or ready restatements. Leave the ordered generation timeout in place.

items.claim: An unfinished task is not a reason to block. With the corrected clock there is no demonstrated close while another legal budget is still open.
items.reason: The reply hold is the absolute Instant turn.started+30s+10s and protects only while now < until. The idle clock is last progress, not the unfinished flag. Close is the later of reply expiry and last PCM plus signed idle. The original report paired samples unchanged from T+40 to T+45 with Close at T+40, which is false when the last sample is at T+40. Output-gate 5s matches the idle floor. Default local receipt 3s sits inside the reply hold. No measured TTS gap was available, so an unverified gap is not a deterministic defect.
items.reopen_if: A real RTC trace shows a close while signed idle since the last PCM is still unelapsed, after the 40s reply instant.
